evidence: users-from-any-host-require-tls: mysql_db.pp:36-38 declare host '%' and tls_options ['SSL'] for the ro account (23-25 the same for rw); puppetlabs-mysql renders that as REQUIRE SSL, which mysql.user stores as ssl_type ANY, so expecting both p8test users at host % with ANY is what the lines produce under the params fixture

the-accounts-read-and-write-as-granted: 17-25 grant ALL to rw and 30-38 grant only SELECT, SHOW VIEW to ro, both over TLS; the action writes as rw over TCP with --ssl-mode=REQUIRED, the ro SELECT reads back the rw row (an independent observation of the write's result in the database), and the ro INSERT gets ERROR 1142 (command denied), exactly what those grants imply; mutates declares the table, row, datadir and answers file

rw-user-logs-in-over-tls: 17-25 give rw its password, host % and REQUIRE SSL; a TCP+TLS login with the fixture password returns CURRENT_USER p8test_rw@%; the mismatch varies only the password, which must make the server refuse the login, so the verdict must change (it failed after apply as required)

purpose covered: Purpose matches the baseline header (mysql_db.pp:1-3) and code: a utf8mb3 database with an rw account and optional ro account, host %, TLS required. The checks test the class doing its job: the database with its charset/collation, both accounts at % with ssl_type ANY and their grants, rw logging in over TLS and writing, ro reading and its write refused (1142), and a login from another host (peer ubuntu2) over TLS answered by puppet8node while the same login without TLS is refused (1045); the MySQL server still runs with no MariaDB replacing it. Uncovered, honestly: the no-ro-account variant and the fail() on a half-given ro pair (lines 9-15) need a second params fixture, and phase3.py takes a single fixture (params|defaults, lines 46/475-481), so capability-lifted. Network restriction is stated by the header as the node firewall's job, not this define's. Reviewer run ALL_PASS, every negative control failed on the clean node.
